Method of Attack: Worm spreading over USB drives infecting systems
Establishes communications with command and control (C2) server
Propagation through USB drives using deceptive LNK shortcuts and hidden malicious DLL copy
Uses Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) to identify target drives and execute malicious scripts
Persistence via scheduled tasks and registry keys
Retrieves C2 IP addresses via domain queries and Telegram channel
Decodes and executes additional payloads from C2
Indicators of Compromise: Scheduled tasks and registry keys for persistence
Deceptive LNK shortcuts on USB drives
Telegram channel for C2 IP retrieval
